name: Klaus Mikaelson (The Original)
description: Play as Niklaus Mikaelson before he broke the curse: the thousand-year-old Original vampire whose werewolf side is still sealed by his mother's curse, with a full curse-breaking questline that ends with the hybrid form.  Built on Xedra Evolved's vampirism.  Adds the old Mikaelson house in New Orleans, the daggered siblings you can wake, a daylight ring, the moonstone, the hidden white oak stake (the only thing that can kill an Original), and a brotherhood of vampire hunters who come for you
